validation.scheme: 4-fold GroupKFold on solver-visible row-component proxy (five-token shingle Jaccard >= 0.45); fold score = equal mean of easy/medium/hard row means, exact official metric

model.order_stage: distance_mesh recast as an interval difference-constraint system; min-plus (Floyd-Warshall) closure decides feasibility; local search collects distinct feasible permutations (70 restarts, up to 45 kept); precedence_cues are hard constraints and fix the reflection symmetry
model.candidate_ranking: LightGBM pointwise chronological score (structural features) blended 0.60/0.40 with Ridge on TF-IDF of masked event/source text
model.consensus: temperature-weighted marginals over the feasible candidate set (temp = 1/3, scaled by n), decoded by local search maximising expected pairwise concordance
model.same_era_model: LightGBM on tight per-pair time-gap bounds from the closure
model.boundary_model: LightGBM break model on consecutive positions, weight 2.0 in the DP
model.segmentation: dynamic programming into exactly era_count contiguous nonempty eras
rejected: score-guided search inside the feasible set (overfits the learned score)
pairwise directed chronology model (net negative once the candidate set grew)
